cards.title: ON-CALL OPERATOR
cards.concept: night-shift ops worker in a plain grey hoodie under a worn utility vest, bare-headed, short dark cropped hair visible, his pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, holding a chunky retro pager up at chest height with one tiny cyan LED blinking on it
cards.hook: Runs internal operations: the first one paged when anything breaks, and the calmest person on the call.

cards.title: ASSET TAGGER
cards.concept: warehouse techie in a grey padded work jacket, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, aiming a boxy handheld barcode scanner at a bare GPU card with a paper asset tag that he holds up at chest height
cards.hook: Compute Labs tokenises GPUs as real-world assets, and operations makes sure every card is tagged and tracked.

cards.title: GPU COURIER
cards.concept: street courier in a grey padded bike jacket with a messenger strap across his chest, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, hugging a dented grey hard case to his chest with a GPU card silhouette stencilled on its side
cards.hook: Operations experience at a Fortune 500 international company: the hardware always arrives where it is needed, on time.

cards.title: SERVER HALL TECH
cards.concept: data-centre floor tech in grey coveralls with a cheap earpiece, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, holding a scuffed rugged tablet at chest height, the dim grey edge of a server rack behind one shoulder
cards.hook: Internal operations is the quiet work of keeping the whole machine running, rack by rack.

cards.title: TELEGRAPH AVE TECH
cards.concept: street electronics repairman in a grey zip hoodie, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, holding a small soldering iron and a bare circuit board steadily up at his chest
cards.hook: A UC Berkeley graduate with Telegraph Avenue grit: steady hands that fix things without fuss.

cards.title: GANTT RUNNER
cards.concept: netrunner in dark techwear with green terminal-code piping, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, a slim cyberdeck open at his chest whose screen shows a few stacked green progress bars, a small green implant on his temple
cards.hook: Project management as netrunning: every task a green bar, every bar on schedule.

cards.title: RACK DRONE PILOT
cards.concept: drone jockey in a grey flight jacket with green trim, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, a compact quad drone with a single cyan lens hovering just above his raised gloved hand at chest height
cards.hook: Operations at scale: an inspection drone patrols the GPU racks so nothing in the hall goes unnoticed.

cards.title: SERVER MEDIC
cards.concept: chrome-medic techie in a grey field jacket with green cross patches, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, a data-cable stethoscope round his neck whose glowing green probe he presses to a GPU card held at his chest
cards.hook: Internal operations means diagnosing what is wrong before it ever becomes a problem.

cards.title: CORPO LIAISON
cards.concept: corporate liaison in a sharp charcoal suit with thin green circuit trim and a small earpiece, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, holding up a glowing green holo business card between two fingers at chest height
cards.hook: Fortune 500 international company experience: fluent in the corporate world, calm in any boardroom.

cards.title: CHIEF OF STACK
cards.concept: operations architect in a long dark coat with glowing teal seams, bare-headed, pale scarf worn as a mantle over his shoulders, a compact stack of three translucent cyan-glowing server layers floating above his open palm at chest height
cards.hook: The Chief of Staff pun rebooted: he runs the whole operating stack of the company.

cards.title: FORTUNE 500 FIXER
cards.concept: cool fixer in a sleek armoured jacket with teal glowing seams and a high collar, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, a teal-glowing data spike held between two fingers at chest height like a deal about to close
cards.hook: Operations experience from a Fortune 500 international company: now the fixer who quietly makes anything happen.

cards.title: ZERO-LAG SAMURAI
cards.concept: street samurai in a dark armoured coat with teal-lit seams, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, the hilt of a holo-katana gripped at his chest with its faint cyan blade rising straight up behind his shoulder, away from his face
cards.hook: Calm, steady focus that cuts every delay before it reaches the team.

cards.title: CHROME RIGHT HAND
cards.concept: augmented chief in dark armour with polished chrome shoulder plates, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, a gleaming chrome cybernetic right hand raised at chest height with a violet holographic sigil ring spinning above the palm, hot-pink neon panels glowing behind him
cards.hook: A Chief of Staff is leadership's right hand, here rebuilt in chrome.

cards.title: SWARM CONDUCTOR
cards.concept: chrome-plated conductor in ornate violet cyber armour, bare-headed, pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, lifting a slim glowing magenta baton at chest height while a few large violet holo panels float in an arc behind his shoulders like an orchestra of screens
cards.hook: Chief of Staff at full power: every team, project and machine in the company playing in time under his quiet direction.

cards.title: PRIME OPERATOR
cards.concept: ascended operator in radiant gold and white chrome regalia, bare-headed, his scarf reborn as a flowing white-and-gold stole of light over his shoulders, a great halo of concentric golden circuit rings set with glowing GPU cores high behind his head, a golden data aura rimming his silhouette
cards.hook: Chief of Staff ascended: the calm prime operator through whom every GPU and every team in the compute world runs.
